mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase olanzapine's CNS effects and risk of cardiac arrhythmias; olanzapine has anticholinergic properties that may worsen amphotericin B-induced nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac status closely; adjust olanzapine dosing based on renal function; consider alternative antifungal if possible; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly.
